variables.user_request: Use the workflow canon skill to review the requirements-refinement workflow. Address these definition defects found in a recent run: (1) HPWT53 sticky-bound to m2ux/workflow-server blocked the first start_session and forced dispatch_child to drop its repo arg; (2) resolve-target has no host-root option in a monorepo so superproject work had to name a component it never touches; (3) setVariable stored {candidate_component.path} unresolved — the gate's own effect writes an unusable value; (4) dispatch-client-workflow is orchestrator work run in a worker, causing depth-2 spawning, duplicated analyze-source (~135k tokens), and harness routing grandchild notifications to the grandparent so the parent concludes children are dead; (5) Planning README has no Progress table so every Progress call site wrote nothing. Defect 4 is the expensive one: a worker that spawns workers violates depth-1-only; taking the child walk over directly at depth 1 stopped it recurring.
